The lack of defined toes and the 'waxy' smoothness of the left hind paw tip are also indicative of generative smoothing rather than just depth-of-field blur. The tail base connection is ambiguous but less severe. I will adjust the artifact score to reflect these structural ambiguities more heavily than the Router's initial assessment.
